key_path: Sign up at console.deepgram.com/signup (email or Google/GitHub)
Console > Project > API Keys > Create (role, expiration, tags)
OR install the CLI (curl https://deepgram.com/install.sh | sh) and run `dg login`, which authorizes in the browser and stores a key in the keyring

agent_native_auth.cli_login_browser_or_device: yes. `dg login` opens the Console to authorize the CLI, with keyring storage and named profiles; `dg whoami`
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes. The Management API creates keys (POST /v1/projects/{id}/keys) and `dg keys` wraps it. The docs say the FIRST key must come from the Console, which conflicts with `dg login`
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. Role-based keys, expiration, tags, plus 30-second temporary JWTs for client-side use
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: partial. Playground with no sign-up for trying models

docs_mcp.issue: The 'Agentic tools' page promotes https://api.dx.deepgram.com/kapa/mcp and https://deepgram.mcp.kapa.ai, and both returned 401 'Authentication required' on 2026-10-11

mcp.product_mcp: local only. `dg mcp` (stdio, or SSE on a port) is built into the CLI and reuses its login. There is also standalone `pip install deepgram-mcp` (github.com/deepgram/mcp, 1 star, last push 2026-05-06), which fetches its tool list from the API at runtime
mcp.one_click_install: `claude mcp add` one-liners. Skills repo github.com/deepgram/skills

docs_for_agents.llms_full_txt: https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt (same size as llms.txt, likely not a full dump)

score_justification: Generous free credit with no card, CLI browser login, a key-management API, and a CLI that doubles as an MCP server. The documented docs-MCP URL is broken and there is no remote OAuth MCP.
best_practice: One CLI handles login, every API call and the MCP server (`dg mcp`), so an agent installs one binary and inherits its auth.
biggest_gap: The advertised docs MCP endpoints return 401, and the product MCP is local-only (stdio/SSE) with no hosted OAuth server.
notes_out_of_date: The 'first key must be created in Console' statement conflicts with `dg login`; the kapa docs-MCP URLs on the agentic-tools page look stale.
